meta.name: rescue
meta.description: Triage an outage, loss of stakeholder trust or a failing engagement direction. Use for urgent recovery; distinguish diagnosis from authorized production mitigation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 突发故障或合作僵局时,快速理清状况并排出恢复步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果线上服务突然中断或重要合作濒临破裂,需要马上定出恢复方案。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a sudden outage or stalled engagement into a clear recovery plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a live outage or a breaking partnership needs a recovery plan right now

howto.what: 出故障、干系人失去信任或项目方向跑偏时,Claude 会先读任务上下文契约与方法文档,再做分诊,给出诊断结论和恢复方向,并把「诊断」和「经授权的生产环境缓解」分开对待。
howto.when: 当你描述线上故障、干系人失去信任或项目方向跑偏、需要紧急恢复时,它会接手;若由 @fde 调用,它复用其已脱敏的信息包和范围,不重开设置或重复提问。

say.text: 线上服务挂了,帮我做紧急分诊,先给诊断结论。
say.note: 它会先读上下文契约和方法再分诊

say.text: 客户已经不信任我们了,帮我评估紧急挽回的方向。
say.note: 按分诊流程给出恢复方向

say.text: 这次只做诊断,不要动生产环境。
say.note: 它会区分诊断与经授权的生产缓解

howto.what_en: When an outage, lost trust or a failing direction hits, Claude reads the task context contract and method, then triages: it produces a diagnosis and recovery direction, separating diagnosis from authorized production mitigation.
howto.when_en: Use it when you describe an outage, lost stakeholder trust or a failing direction that needs urgent recovery; if called by @fde it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting.

say_en.text: Our service is down - triage it and give me a diagnosis first.
say_en.note: It reads the context contract and method before triaging.

say_en.text: The client no longer trusts us; help me work out urgent recovery.
say_en.note: It returns a recovery direction from the triage flow.

say_en.text: Diagnosis only this time - don't touch production.
say_en.note: It separates diagnosis from authorized mitigation.
